name: street-block

situations.name: street-traverse
situations.description: Fly the length of the street between parked cars, a bus and lamp heads.

situations.name: intersection-turn
situations.description: Turn north at the intersection under a signal mast arm and pass a delivery van.

situations.name: under-the-skybridge
situations.description: Follow the north-south road under a glass skybridge, then turn west along the street.

situations.name: through-the-passage
situations.description: Leave the street through a 4 m covered passage into the back lane.

situations.name: over-the-bus
situations.description: Climb over a parked bus beneath lamp heads and the tram wire, then descend.

description: Crossroads with set-back buildings, a covered passage, skybridge, bus stop, trees, signals and parked vehicles.
